candidate_changes.evidence: W2 |gap|≥3 on 8 games: model beat market MAE on 4/8. Hits: DET@BUF, MIA@SF, MIN@CHI, LV@LAC. Misses: JAX@DEN (15pt), GB@NYJ (12pt), PIT@NE (9pt), IND@KC (5.5pt). Extreme gaps (≥8) went 1/4 beat (only if counting none of the ≥8 as beats — DET was 3.78). Gaps ≥8: JAX/GB/PIT all lost to market.
candidate_changes.confirm_if: Across W3–W6, |gap|≥8 continues to lose to market MAE on ≥70% of those games
candidate_changes.falsify_if: |gap|≥8 starts beating close MAE on 4+ consecutive such games

candidate_changes.evidence: Large |pff_ytd|≥2 in layers: GB@NYJ +4.0 (catastrophe vs market), JAX@DEN −4.0 (catastrophe), IND@KC +4 (lost to market), PHI@TEN −4 (strong — but aligned with market), LV@LAC −3.94 (beat market on dog lean). 1-week n; mixed.
candidate_changes.confirm_if: pff_ytd-driven |gap|≥3 loses to market MAE for 4+ more weeks
candidate_changes.falsify_if: pff_ytd-driven gaps beat market MAE on 6+ games through W6
